input: Enroll in a free online ethics in AI course

gold.taskTitle: Enroll in a Free Online AI Ethics Course
gold.taskDescription: Find and enroll in a free online course covering ethics in artificial intelligence.

questions.title: What is your current knowledge level in AI?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced learner helps identify the right course difficulty.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred learning platform in mind?
questions.description: The user may already have an account or preference for platforms like Coursera, edX, or FutureLearn.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you dedicate to studying?
questions.description: Time availability determines whether a short intensive course or a longer flexible one is more suitable.

questions.title: Do you need a certificate upon course completion?
questions.description: Some free courses offer paid certificates; knowing this helps filter options that meet the user's goals.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing this course?
questions.description: A target completion date helps narrow down courses by duration and pacing.

questions.title: Is there a specific area of AI ethics you want to focus on?
questions.description: AI ethics is broad; the user may care most about bias, privacy, regulation, or another specific topic.

questions.title: Are you enrolling for personal growth or professional reasons?
questions.description: The motivation behind enrolling shapes which course depth, framing, and credential type is most valuable.
